questions.q: If financial information is made available to decision-makers early enough to be capable of influencing their economic decisions, the information possesses the qualitative characteristic of
questions.explain: **Timeliness** is a qualitative characteristic that means having information available to users in time to be capable of influencing their decisions. Information generally loses its relevance if it is unnecessarily delayed, no matter how accurate it is.

questions.q: Which qualitative characteristic is primarily violated if an accountant deliberately overstates expenses in the Trading, Profit and Loss Account to reduce reported net profit?
questions.explain:
**Reliability** (or Faithful Representation) dictates that financial information must be free from material error and bias, accurately reflecting the true economic events. 

Deliberately manipulating figures (such as overstating expenses to hide profits) introduces bias and renders the financial statements unreliable and unfaithful to the actual economic reality.
